_comment: Gen-5 Elysium MAINNET config (99901). Filled 2026-11-09 during mainnet prep. Every address bytecode-/identity-verified on 99901 — see docs/reports/elysium-mainnet-2026-11-09.md for how each was verified. Mainnet is a pure config swap: same scripts as testnet, this file. DEPLOY ORDER: (batch 1) create the Safe via the canonical v1.3.0 proxy factory at the DETERMINISTIC address below, THEN (batch 2) run DeployElysium.

infra._comment: All verified present on 99901 (cast codesize). create2Deployer is exactly 69 bytes = canonical Arachnid deployer. Safe v1.3.0 canonical contracts ALREADY have code on 99901 — no Safe infra deploy needed.

tokens._comment: whype: name/symbol WHYPE, decimals 18 (verified on 99901). usdc: symbol USDC, decimals 6 (USDC.e). USDC is NOT a green quote asset on launch (WHYPE only); recorded for reference.

v4._comment: poolManager: genuine Uniswap v4 PoolManager bytecode — byte-identical to the official Robinhood-Chain (4663) v4 PoolManager except for the 20-byte embedded self-address (same solc 0.8.26, same metadata CBOR). NOT on Uniswap's official deployments list (99901 absent). HUMAN SIGN-OFF REQUIRED before mainnet: confirm this is the canonical Elysium v4 (not the Elyspump fork). The DeployElysium script only reads .v4.poolManager; the periphery below is frontend/SDK-only and must be independently verified before swaps are wired.

params._comment: protocolBurnDestination = the Ballast Safe (2-of-2 min of 3 owners) — burn-design option 1: WHYPE accrues to the Safe for $BALLAST buyback & burn once a bridge is live. IMMUTABLE in the vault at construction.

router._comment: FeeRouterV5 construction params, shared across every launch.

owner._comment: protocolOwner = the Ballast Safe (v1.3.0, 2-of-3). DETERMINISTIC address, proven on an anvil fork of 99901 via createProxyWithNonce(singleton=0xd9Db270c..., initializer=setup([0xBfD4F1E8,0x3810a51b,0x594527d8], threshold=2, 0, 0x, fallbackHandler=0xf48f2B2d..., 0,0,0), saltNonce=0x42414c4c4153540001). getOwners/getThreshold/VERSION all confirmed. Must be deployed (batch 1) BEFORE the gen-5 core (batch 2). The factory is handed over via Ownable2Step; the Safe calls acceptOwnership().
